title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Hybrid working, up to 3 days per week in the Exeter office

About Us

Webrecruit helps organisations across the UK attract and recruit talent through a combination of recruitment advertising services, applicant tracking technology and careers site solutions. Working with organisations across the private, public, higher education and not-for-profit sectors, we combine recruitment advertising expertise with technology to help employers improve how they attract and manage candidates.

As we continue to develop our services and grow our customer base, we re looking for a commercially driven Sales Executive to help us win new business, build lasting customer relationships and contribute to our continued growth. The role is offered on a permanent, full-time basis, working 40 hours per week.

The Benefits
- £30,000 - £35,000 base salary
- Commission scheme with uncapped earning potential
- Pension scheme
- Up to 25 days' holiday + public holidays

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated sales professional who loves winning new business and building lasting customer relationships to join our growing team.

You'll have the chance to develop your sales career, build your own customer portfolio and expand your knowledge of recruitment advertising and technology.

What's more, with uncapped commission, your hard work and sales success will be directly rewarded, giving you the potential to significantly boost your earnings.

The Role

As our Sales Executive, you'll focus on winning new customers and growing sales of our recruitment advertising services.

You'll reach out to potential customers through cold calling and prospecting, find out about their recruitment needs and show them how our services can help. You'll build relationships, handle objections and turn new opportunities into sales.

You'll also look after existing customers, keeping in touch to secure repeat business and identify opportunities to introduce our wider recruitment solutions, including our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and careers sites.

Additionally, you will:
- Build and manage your sales pipeline using Salesforce
- Prepare quotes and proposals and respond to customer enquiries
- Work towards agreed sales activity, conversion and revenue targets
- Work with colleagues to support customers and develop new opportunities
- Share customer feedback and market insights with the wider team

About You

To be considered as our Sales Executive, you will need:
- Previous experience in a target-driven sales role, either B2 B or B2 C
- Confidence in cold calling, generating new business, handling objections and closing sales
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- Good commercial awareness and organisational skills
- A motivated, resilient approach and the drive to achieve targets

Previous experience in recruitment advertising, recruitment technology or B2 B services would be advantageous but is not essential.

We re particularly interested in people who combine the drive and confidence to win new customers with the interpersonal skills and commercial curiosity needed to develop long-term relationships.

Other organisations may call this role Business Development Executive, BDE, Advertising Sales Executive, B2 B Sales Executive, New Business Sales Executive, Sales Account Manager, Account Executive, or Account Manager.

Webrecruit is an equal opportunities employer, values diversity and is strongly committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants. We believe that an inclusive working environment helps our people and our business succeed.

If you re a motivated sales professional who enjoys winning new business, building lasting customer relationships and developing your own portfolio of clients, we d love to hear from you.

Apply today to take the next step in your sales career with Webrecruit.

In this role the successful candidate would be responsible for account management, closing warm leads as well as doing your own lead generation through both cold calling/knocking and conducting site visits for leads.

This role would suit a sales executive or similar with a background in the construction/building supplies industry, has experience both closing warm leads and generating their own and is looking to join a market leading company that offers great up-skilling and career development opportunities.

The role:
- 2 Site visits a week to close deals/win new business
- Generating new clientele as well as some account management/warm leads
- 8:30 til 5 Monday to Friday
- Managing your own desk

The person:
- Sales Executive or similar
- Background in Construction/Building Supplies
- Commutable to South Brent

title: Trainee Advertising Sales Executive
description:
Trainee Advertising Sales Executive

Hybrid working, up to 3 days per week in the Exeter office

About Us

Webrecruit helps organisations across the UK attract and recruit talent through a combination of recruitment advertising services, applicant tracking technology and careers site solutions. Working with organisations across the private, public, higher education and not-for-profit sectors, we combine recruitment advertising expertise with technology to help employers improve how they attract and manage candidates.

We're expanding our sales team and have an exciting opening for a Trainee Advertising Sales Executive to join us on full-time, permanent basis, working 40 hours per week.

The Benefits
- 30,000 - 35,000 base salary
- Commission scheme with uncapped earning potential
- Pension scheme
- Up to 25 days' holiday + public holidays

This is a fantastic opportunity for an ambitious sales professional to gain new skills and take their career in a new direction with our growing, established company.

You'll have the chance to develop in-depth recruitment sales experience within our supportive environment. With backing from multiple teams, you'll be enabled to make a real success of your new role, building on your existing sales skills and gaining specialist knowledge and experience.

What's more, you'll enjoy a superb rewards package, with a competitive base rate, complimented by uncapped commission that gives you the potential to increase your earnings as you progress. Combined with hybrid working, you'll have the flexibility to balance your career ambitions with life outside work.

The Role

As our Trainee Advertising Sales Executive, we'll equip you with the skills to sell our recruitment advertising services to employers across the UK.

Once you've developed an understanding of our products and services, you'll be engaging with potential clients across the country, making calls and creatin conversations about how we can help them succeed.

With your initial focus on business development, you will seek to address the recruitment challenges of our clients, managing sales opportunities through to close.

Additionally, you will:
- Establish ongoing client relationships, encourage repeat business
- Maintain a sales pipeline
- Keep accurate customer records using our Salesforce CRM system
- Respond to inbound enquiries and prepare customer quotations and proposals

About You

To be considered as our Trainee Advertising Sales Executive, you will need:
- Sales experience
- Good communication and interpersonal skills
- The ability to build positive customer relationships
- Good organisational skills
- A motivated and resilient approach
- A willingness to learn and develop new skills

Other organisations may call this role Trainee Sales Executive, Junior Sales Executive, Advertising Sales Executive, Sales Representative, Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative, BDR, Junior Business Development Executive, or Trainee Account Executive.

Webrecruit is an equal opportunities employer, values diversity and is strongly committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants. We believe that an inclusive working environment helps our people and our business succeed.

If you have sales experience, a willingness to learn and the ambition to develop a career in recruitment advertising, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to take the next step in your sales career with Webrecruit.
